checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: ~10s widescreen video with friendly intelligible English voice-over explaining the cycle
must.why: 10 s 16:9 with audio at normal level, but words can't be judged.

must.item: Water rises as vapor, clouds form, rain falls, in order
must.why: Vapor over ocean and clouds appear, but no rain is visible; the end is a river in mountains.

must.item: Labels read exactly Evaporation, Condensation, Precipitation
Each label legible and with its stage in order

faults.what: No rain or precipitation shown; the stage is missing.
Not a bright animated style; it is photoreal drone-like footage.
Four stages are blended into continuous shots, so the sequence is vague. Collection is only implied by a river.

summary: A pretty photoreal clip of sun, ocean mist, clouds and a mountain river came out, but it has no rain, no stage labels and no animated style, so it explains the water cycle poorly.
